text.name: Sovereign Wealth Funds
text.rules: Record "petro-dollars". LIO chooses: Let them buy in? If yes, draw from the Contingency deck of the side that played this card, then if the result is 3 or more, LIO spends 2 points on one action; otherwise, LIO spends 1 point on actions; either way, at the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point placing influence. If no, LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: As the credit crisis spread in late 2007, state funds bought stakes in Western banks, including Abu Dhabi's $7.5 billion investment in Citigroup in November 2007 and China Investment Corporation's purchase of a Morgan Stanley stake in December 2007.
